respuesta.razonamiento: Merged the three stick figure boxes (b0, b1, b2) representing internal NHS Digital teams into a single UserCompanyAnalyst node. Mapped 'AD' (b8) to DirectoryService. Identified the two distinct EC2 instances: b3 as the Guacamole gateway authenticating via DirectoryService, and b9 as the analytics compute running tools like RStudio/JupyterHub. All 6 drawn lines map directly to edges, enriched with spoken details for authentication, EMR reading from S3, and KMS encryption.
